Hi Amit —

We missed you for the discovery call that was scheduled for 9:00 AM PT. No worries — I know schedules slip. If you're still interested in talking through Redwood's inference platform, I can offer three quick paths so we don't lose momentum: 

1) Auto-book (fastest): use this one-click link and it will pop the best 15-min slots into my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min?code=AUTO123

3) Async/on-demand: if you prefer, here’s an on-demand demo + short sandbox you can try now (no meeting required): https://redwoodinference.app/on-demand-demo/finpulse-snapshot. I attached a one-pager with highlights.

If you'd like a deeper product conversation, I can loop in Marissa (AE) to coordinate a 30-min slot.

Which path is easiest for you?
